name: omaipsum
author: Carsten
description: Placeholder text from the bar: six variants, exact counts, one click to copy.

barWidget.description: Generate words, sentences or paragraphs of placeholder text and copy them.

schema.label: Default variant
schema.description: The id of a file in corpora/ — classic, bacon or corporate. A variant is one JSON file, so an enum here would have to be edited every time one is added; an unknown id falls back to the first variant.

schema.label: Default unit
schema.description: What the count counts when the pulldown opens.

schema.label: Default amount
schema.description: How many of the unit above to generate on open. The pulldown clamps per unit, so this is a starting point rather than a limit.
